tasks.spec: You are a one-task Ringer probe worker isolating why createDocument lineItems newCostItem elements fail union resolution in JobTread Pave. Twenty staged documents fail with: The value {"newCostItem":{name, unitId, quantity, unitPrice, costCodeId, costTypeId, description}} at createDocument.$.lineItems.0 does not resolve to existingCostGroup/existingCostItem/newCostGroup/newCostItem. Hypotheses: (A) document-context newCostItem rejects costCodeId/costTypeId keys; (B) the specific costTypeId used ('22PazefY5x4j') or costCodeId ('22PbdLkpZX5s') is invalid in this context; (C) some other inner-field constraint (e.g. name length). BOUNDARY: you may create AT MOST 3 temporary documents on ONE pilot job in JobTread org 22PazeRM5FCH, and you MUST delete every document you create before finishing (deleteDocument op) and prove deletion by read-back; no other mutations of any kind; never touch existing entities; deliverables are your only file writes; never log the grant key. CREDS: set -a; source /Users/chussey/.config/cleverwork/master.env; set +a. Build request bodies with python3 json.dumps only. Pave: POST https://api.jobtread.com/pave with {"query": {"$": {"grantKey": "<$JT_SUPABASE_MIRROR_GRANT_KEY>"}, ...}}. Pick the target job: any jt_id from jt_mirror.crosswalk where jt_type='job' (Supabase read: curl -s -X POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/rnhmvcpsvtqjlffpsayu/database/query -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"select jt_id from jt_mirror.crosswalk where jt_type='\''job'\'' limit 1"}'). PRIOR ROUNDS (../r3h-lineitem-probe/, ../r3h2-lineitem-probe/, ../r3h4-lineitem-probe/): wrapped variants fail; bare objects with any key combination fail. NEW HYPOTHESIS: Pave (the query language JobTread uses) discriminates typed objects with a '_type' tag — the API README notes '_type' appears on response objects; input unions likely require it too. PROBE SEQUENCE (stop at first success): V12 = lineItems: [ {"_type": "newCostItem", "name": "Probe Item", "unitId": <real unit id>, "quantity": 1, "unitCost": 8, "unitPrice": 10, "costCodeId": "22PbdLkpZX5s", "costTypeId": "22PazefY5x4j", "description": "probe"} ]. V13 = lineItems: [ {"_type": "existingCostItem", "costItemId": <jt_id of an executed catalog_items row from jt_mirror.crosswalk jt_type='costItem'>, "quantity": 1} ]. V14 = minimal _type: [ {"_type": "newCostItem", "name": "Probe Item", "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": 10} ]. V15 (only if V12-V14 fail): try _type values with different casing ('NewCostItem') and record errors precisely. Record each full request (grantKey redacted) and full response. CLEANUP: deleteDocument each created id, then re-query it and show null/error proof. DELIVERABLES: /Users/chussey/Documents/a-roofers-open-brain/integrations/bridges/jobtread/mirror/r3h4-lineitem-probe/probe-output.json (array of {variant, request, response, cleanup}) and .../r3h4-lineitem-probe/probe-transcript.md with sections ## Probe Goal, ## Commands Run, ## Observed Behavior, ## Winning Shape (exact JSON element shape that succeeded, or 'none succeeded'), ## Cleanup Proof, ## Verdict. HARD RULES: never claim a variant worked unless the response contained a created document id; if all fail, that is a valid honest outcome — capture every error verbatim.
